messages.subject: NavlistPanel reset
parts:
Hi!

My app basically has a structure as follows:

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
    sidebarPanel()
    mainPanel(
        tabsetPanel(
            tabPanel("One",
                  navlistPanel(
                      tabPanel("One-A"...
                      tabPanel("One-B", # a long computation process is here
                  )
             tabPanel("Two",
)

So, for example I can go to tab "One", and then to "One-B", and then to "Two". My problem is that after this sequence of tab-visiting, when I go back to "One", I would like to have the app switch back to "One-A" immediately rather than to "One-B". This is because I have a long computation in "One-B" that constantly gets repeated.

Any idea how this can be done?

Thanks!!

WZ

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: NavlistPanel reset
parts:
I'm not sure if updateTabsetPanel will work with a navlistPanel, but it's worth a shot. Call it from an observe({...}) in server.R whenever Two is selected.

Or better yet, make the long calculation in One-B behind an actionButton... Probably a better user experience that way.
